title: The Dow Jumped 1,570 Points After the Midterms. Here's Why #shorts
description:
The day after the 2026 midterms (Nov 4, 2026), the Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 1,569 points (+3.0%), its best day since April 2025. The S&P 500 rose 1.6%.

Why? Markets dislike uncertainty, and analysts said the end of election uncertainty helped lift stocks (CNN, CNBC, Nov 4, 2026).

This midterm is projected to cost about $11.9 billion, the most for any midterm (OpenSecrets projection). That's about $35 for every person in the US (US Census population, 343.1 million).

History: the S&P 500 was higher one year after all 19 midterms since 1950. That's history, not a promise.

Sources: Dow (^DJI) and S&P 500 (^GSPC) closes Nov 3-4, 2026 via Yahoo Finance; OpenSecrets spending projection; US Census Bureau population via FRED (POPTHM).
This video doesn't take a side in the election.
